notes.title: CHIP: Rescuer of Kittens joins the Steam Debut Festival 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36570147/527c9e94217816f86b0efd7a1fbff47e8209b138.jpg[/img]
Greetings!  
[b]CHIP: Rescuer of Kittens[/b] is part of the [b]Steam Debut Festival 2025[/b] — a festival where debut games reach a wide audience for the very first time! This is our first major game, and we’re excited to invite you to join the adventure through the free demo.

Rescue adorable kittens and face off against the evil Dr. Meowcraft.

Thank you for supporting us — indie developers taking our very first steps.  
Play the demo, share your impressions, and join the discussion with fellow kitten rescuers in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/REsGgmh6Fq]official Discord[/url] community!

[u][h2]Publisher’s Note[/h2][/u]  
Discover new genres, fresh ideas, and one-of-a-kind worlds crafted by passionate debut creators from around the globe — all as part of the Steam Debut Festival 2025.

These games are more than just first projects — they’re honest, heartfelt creations built with the pure love of making games.

notes.title: 🐾 CHIP: Rescuer of Kittens at Games From Russia 2025! 🐾
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36570147/ae59d59c97392acf2102c13f4b76180535aff31a.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to announce that CHIP: Rescuer of Kittens is taking part in Games From Russia 2025 — the largest online festival of Russian-speaking video games, happening on Steam from May 1 to May 9!

Games From Russia is the first and biggest online showcase dedicated to games created in Russia and by the Russian-speaking development community. Expect exclusive trailers, gameplay demos, discounts, and a wide variety of lovingly crafted projects.

CHIP: Rescuer of Kittens is a heartfelt and dynamic adventure about a brave hero saving kittens in a futuristic world. We’re thrilled to present the game at a festival that brings together top developers from Russia, the CIS, and Russian-speaking studios around the globe.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029830/CHIP_Rescuer_of_Kittens/

Join the festival and help save as many kittens as possible!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/43785639/view/4490745531935490552
